handoff: Review approve: AC1–AC10 met with tests at the cli seam (tidy window/refusals before the lock, day-pair pruning sparing workflows/, dry-run bytes, idempotent second run, doctor warning+hint never failing, ticks never prune, why tick_pruned only when older than window and day gone); PRD O7 added; slice checks and typecheck green. Two non-blocking nits: bare catch around statSync in traceDaysBefore, formatBytes can print 1000.0 KB.

findings.title: statSync failure is skipped with a bare catch
findings.detail:
traceDaysBefore swallows every statSync error (`catch { continue; }`), not only ENOENT from a file that disappeared between readdir and stat. An EACCES, for example, would hide the day from tidy and doctor without saying so.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Skip only on isErrno(e, 'ENOENT') and rethrow anything else, as the readdir branch above already does.

findings.title: formatBytes can print 1000.0 KB
findings.detail:
A value between 999,950 and 999,999 bytes rounds to `1000.0 KB` instead of `1.0 MB`, because the loop tests the value before rounding.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Move to the next unit when v.toFixed(1) would reach 1000.
